AnswerRequest.description:
Ask + synthesize: retrieve a context pack, then have the configured
LLM produce a cited answer/decision. With neither subject nor scope,
subjects are auto-resolved from entity names mentioned in the question.
AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

AskRequest.description:
Two time axes (docs/architecture.md, D-024/D-046): `as_of` = what did
we KNOW at T, measured on observation time (`observed_at <= as_of`:
when the source asserted it), the closest proxy to knowledge time for
backfilled corpora, where `recorded_at` is load day; `recorded_at`
remains the audit column. `valid_at` = what was TRUE at T (fact time —
only observations whose validity window covers T survive, and facts
with no window at all are kept). A fact scheduled for after T but
asserted before it is part of the `as_of` view; hiding it is
`valid_at`'s job.

budget.description: token budget; mandatory cap (LOOM_MAX_BUDGET is the real ceiling)
budget.title: Budget

AskRequest.title: AskRequest

Citation.description:
What backs a context item: an observation (facts, conflicts, briefs)
or a span of a stored document (excerpts). At least one of
observation_id / artifact_id is set (D-023).
Citation.title: Citation

ClaimIn.description: Structured, entity-addressed ingestion payload. Maps ~1:1 to an Observation.

event_id.description: sender-supplied idempotency key; redelivery of the same (namespace, event_id) is deduplicated instead of duplicated (D-014)
event_id.title: Event Id

supersedes.description: id of an earlier observation this one corrects or replaces (same namespace). Recorded, never inferred: the old row stays for audit and for as_of reads before this one, but is no longer current — it drops out of conflict detection and ranks as history (D-050)
supersedes.title: Supersedes

ClaimIn.title: ClaimIn

ContextItem.description:
Every item is cited (hard constraint 3): facts and conflicts cite
observations, briefs cite the observations they were synthesized from,
excerpts cite the artifact span they quote.
ContextItem.title: ContextItem

ContextPack.description: The unit of retrieval: budgeted, ranked, cited, expandable.

charged_tokens.description: what the pack charged against `budget`, in its compact rendered form: every item's text plus its citations, and every handle's hint plus id. At most `budget`, except that a pack too small to hold one handle beside an item still ships its first handle (D-051)
charged_tokens.title: Charged Tokens

omitted_handles.description: expansion threads that existed beyond the handle cap; narrow the scope or raise the budget to see them (D-035)
omitted_handles.title: Omitted Handles

truncated.description: entities whose observations exceeded the gather limit: coverage is partial there, so absence cannot be concluded (D-038)
truncated.title: Truncated

ContextPack.title: ContextPack

DocumentIn.description: Unstructured ingestion payload. Stored verbatim as an artifact, mined async.
DocumentIn.title: DocumentIn

EntityRef.description: Address of an entity by natural key, e.g. host:web-01.
EntityRef.title: EntityRef

ExpansionHandle.description:
Opaque 'there is more here' pointer; feed back to expand().
kind says what was left out: more observations of one predicate, or a
whole conflict that didn't fit the budget (never silently dropped).
ExpansionHandle.title: ExpansionHandle

IngestItemResult.description:
Outcome of one envelope in a batch (D-034). `rejected` items carry
the reason; the rest of the batch still lands — a shipper's bad record
never blocks its good ones.
IngestItemResult.title: IngestItemResult

containment.description: a 'contains / member of' relation: scopes with no explicit `expand` follow every containment predicate (D-012/D-024)
containment.title: Containment

object_types.description: allowed object entity types; empty = any entity or scalar
object_types.title: Object Types

Provenance.description:
Where an observation came from: an artifact and, optionally, a span.
Extracted claims carry the artifact's id; a sender that ingests a
document and structured claims about it in the same pipeline does not
know the id yet, so it may cite the document by its own `event_id`
instead — resolved to `artifact_id` at ingest (D-039). The document
must land first (same batch is fine: documents are stored before the
batch's claims); an unresolvable reference rejects the claim.
Provenance.title: Provenance

SchemaRegistration.description:
Per-namespace registry (D-024). Registering is additive (a later POST
merges by name). Validation on ingest: a registered predicate's
object_types are always enforced; with `strict` the namespace also
rejects unregistered predicates and entity types.
SchemaRegistration.title: SchemaRegistration

ScopeSpec.description:
The set of entities a question is about — several computers, or an
anchor plus everything related to it ("domain X and its contents").

`expand` names the containment/relational predicates to follow outward
from the subjects (e.g. ["member_of"]); `depth` bounds the traversal.

follow_extracted.description: also traverse edges that were extracted from documents (D-023 second-class witnesses); off by default so a hostile document cannot rewrite the topology a scope walks (D-046)
follow_extracted.title: Follow Extracted

subjects.description: anchors of the scope; bounded so one request cannot name a whole namespace (expansion is how a scope grows, D-046)
subjects.title: Subjects

ScopeSpec.title: ScopeSpec

ScopeTruncation.description:
An entity whose observations exceeded the gather limit: only the
newest `gathered` of `total` were examined. A reader must not conclude
absence about it — "no KEV fact among the kernel's CVEs" means nothing
when 1,740 of 2,740 were never looked at (D-038).
ScopeTruncation.title: ScopeTruncation

SemanticMatch.description:
An entity surfaced by meaning rather than by name (D-025): the best
matching fact is the evidence, cited like any pack item.
SemanticMatch.title: SemanticMatch

get.description:
Entities related to a question by meaning (D-025): needs an embedder
on the serving engine (LOOM_EMBED_*) and the worker to have embedded
the namespace; each match cites its best-matching fact.

Raw observations touching an entity (audit/debug). The rows pass the
same gates as a pack's contents (D-021): a type-scoped reader never
sees an edge to an entity outside their world here either. `as_of`
and `valid_at` apply the same two time axes as /v1/ask (D-046).

post.description:
Many envelopes in one request (D-034): a JSON array or NDJSON, up to
LOOM_MAX_BATCH items. Each item passes the same gates as /v1/ingest and
is reported individually — one bad record never blocks the rest. Claims
land in one transaction per store. Idempotent per item via event_id.

get.description:
One observation's provenance as PROV-O JSON-LD (D-050): source
agent, observed time, the artifact span it was derived from, the
extraction activity, and the supersession chain. Gated like the raw
observations route: the reader's namespace, and every entity the
observation touches must be in their world — anything else is
unknown to them, not forbidden.

schema.title: Response Observation Provenance V1 Observations  Observation Id  Prov Get

post.description:
Register (additively) the entity types and predicates of a namespace —
the domain knowledge that keeps the core domain-agnostic (D-024).
Requires an *ungated* write key: a shipper pinned to two entity types
and one source must not be able to flip the namespace's `strict` or
widen its predicates (D-046). Returns the effective registry.
